title: 血管外科
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋主動脈瘤的監測與開放／腔內修補、頸動脈與周邊動脈疾病、急性肢體缺血、糖尿病足與截肢決策、靜脈疾病、透析通路、血管外傷與術後加護照護，以師徒工作台方式練習每一步的決策與安全檢查。
introEn: This library covers aneurysm surveillance and open/endovascular repair, carotid and peripheral arterial disease, acute limb ischaemia, the diabetic foot and amputation decisions, venous disease, dialysis access, vascular trauma and postoperative critical care, practised step by step on the mentor workbench.

procedures.title: 血管外科門診評估：ABI 與雙功能超音波
procedures.titleEn: Vascular clinic assessment: ABI and duplex
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：68 歲男性，吸菸 40 包年、第 2 型糖尿病，走約 200 公尺即右小腿酸痛、站立休息數分鐘緩解。本情境僅供教學推理，不取代個別臨床判斷。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 68-year-old man, 40 pack-years, type 2 diabetes, right calf ache after about 200 m that settles with standing rest. Teaching scenario only; it does not replace individual clinical judgement.

stages.title: 鑑別血管性與神經性跛行
stages.evidence: 小腿痛在固定距離出現，站著不動即緩解；無腰痛，前彎坐下不是必要條件。
stages.evidenceEn: Calf pain at a reproducible distance, relieved by standing still; no back pain; sitting or flexing is not needed for relief.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?
stages.reason: 固定距離誘發、站立即緩解是動脈供血不足的典型；神經性跛行需坐下或前彎才緩解。
stages.reasonEn: Reproducible distance and relief on standing point to arterial insufficiency; neurogenic pain needs sitting or flexion to settle.
stages.pitfall: 若誤判為神經性：延誤 PAD 診斷，病人的心肌梗塞與中風風險持續未被處理。
stages.pitfallEn: If mislabelled neurogenic: PAD diagnosis is delayed and the patient's MI and stroke risk goes unmanaged.

stages.title: 系統性脈搏觸診
stages.evidence: 右側股脈搏正常、膕脈搏減弱、足背與脛後脈搏觸不到；左側皆可觸及。
stages.evidenceEn: Right femoral normal, popliteal weak, dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial absent; all palpable on the left.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 以 ABI 作為第一線客觀檢查
choices.en: Use ABI as first-line objective test
Refer for surgery on absent pulses alone

stages.reason: ABI 便宜、非侵入且可量化嚴重度；侵入性檢查只在規劃血運重建時才需要。
stages.reasonEn: ABI is cheap, non-invasive and quantifies severity; invasive imaging is reserved for revascularisation planning.
stages.pitfall: 若跳過 ABI 直接侵入性檢查：暴露於對比劑與穿刺風險，且缺乏日後比較的基準值。
stages.pitfallEn: Skipping ABI exposes the patient to contrast and puncture risk and leaves no baseline for future comparison.

stages.title: 足部皮膚與潰瘍檢查
stages.titleEn: Inspect the foot for ischaemic change
stages.evidence: 右足趾間 5 mm 潰瘍、皮膚薄亮無毛、抬高後蒼白、下垂後發紅。
stages.evidenceEn: 5 mm interdigital ulcer, shiny hairless skin, pallor on elevation and dependent rubor on the right foot.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 慢性肢體威脅性缺血徵象

stages.reason: 抬高蒼白與下垂發紅（Buerger 徵象）加組織缺損，提示缺血已威脅肢體，需加速評估。
stages.reasonEn: Elevation pallor with dependent rubor (Buerger's sign) plus tissue loss indicates limb-threatening ischaemia and needs expedited work-up.
stages.pitfall: 若當作一般潰瘍換藥：缺血性潰瘍不會癒合，感染擴散可導致截肢。
stages.pitfallEn: Treated as a routine ulcer, an ischaemic wound will not heal and spreading infection can end in amputation.

stages.title: 正確量測 ABI
stages.evidence: 仰臥休息 10 分鐘；右踝最高壓 80 mmHg，雙臂最高收縮壓 150 mmHg。
stages.evidenceEn: Supine rest 10 minutes; highest right ankle pressure 80 mmHg, highest brachial pressure of both arms 150 mmHg.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?
stages.reason: ABI = 踝最高壓 ÷ 雙臂最高壓；0.5–0.9 為輕中度，≤0.4 通常對應嚴重缺血。
stages.reasonEn: ABI = highest ankle pressure / highest brachial pressure; 0.5-0.9 is mild-moderate, ≤0.4 usually severe ischaemia.
stages.pitfall: 若以較低的臂壓當分母：ABI 被高估，鎖骨下狹窄病人會被誤判為正常。
stages.pitfallEn: Using the lower arm pressure as denominator overestimates ABI and misses disease in patients with subclavian stenosis.

stages.title: ABI 高於 1.4 的鈣化血管
stages.evidence: 左側 ABI 1.45，但病人左腿亦有典型跛行；糖尿病多年。
stages.evidenceEn: Left ABI 1.45 yet typical claudication on the left; long-standing diabetes.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 鈣化不可壓縮，改測 TBI 或波形

stages.reason: 內側鈣化使動脈不可壓縮，ABI 失去意義；趾動脈較少鈣化，TBI 與波形更可靠。
stages.reasonEn: Medial calcification makes arteries incompressible and the ABI meaningless; toe arteries calcify less, so TBI and waveforms are more reliable.
stages.pitfall: 若把假性正常 ABI 當作無病：糖尿病與腎病患者的真正缺血被漏診。
stages.pitfallEn: Accepting a falsely normal ABI misses real ischaemia in diabetic and renal patients.

stages.title: 判讀都卜勒波形
stages.evidence: 右足背動脈波形單相、低振幅、上升緩慢；左側三相。
stages.evidenceEn: Right dorsalis pedis waveform monophasic, low amplitude with slow upstroke; triphasic on the left.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 近端有顯著阻塞性病變

stages.reason: 三相波代表健康彈性血管；單相緩升波形反映近端狹窄或阻塞後的衰減血流。
stages.reasonEn: Triphasic flow reflects healthy compliant arteries; a dampened monophasic waveform means flow downstream of proximal stenosis or occlusion.
stages.pitfall: 若忽視波形只看壓力數值：鈣化血管中波形是唯一可靠的嚴重度線索。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignoring waveforms and trusting pressures alone loses the only reliable severity clue in calcified vessels.

stages.title: 靜態 ABI 正常時的運動測試
stages.titleEn: Exercise testing when resting ABI is normal
stages.evidence: 另一病人症狀典型但靜態 ABI 0.95；跑步機後 ABI 降至 0.65。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient has typical symptoms but resting ABI 0.95; after treadmill the ABI falls to 0.65.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 運動後顯著下降，確認血管性跛行
choices.en: Significant post-exercise fall confirms vascular claudication

stages.reason: 運動增加肌肉血流需求，狹窄處壓力階差放大；運動後 ABI 明顯下降可揭露靜態漏診的病變。
stages.reasonEn: Exercise raises muscle demand and unmasks the pressure gradient across a stenosis; a clear post-exercise ABI fall reveals disease missed at rest.
stages.pitfall: 若僅憑靜態 ABI 排除：輕中度狹窄病人被告知正常，繼續惡化。
stages.pitfallEn: Excluding PAD on a resting ABI alone sends patients with moderate stenosis home as normal while disease progresses.

stages.title: 雙功能超音波定位病灶
stages.evidence: 右淺股動脈中段峰值流速比 >2，遠端波形轉為單相。
stages.evidenceEn: Mid right superficial femoral artery peak systolic velocity ratio >2 with monophasic flow distally.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?
stages.reason: 狹窄處流速加倍（PSV ratio ≥2）加遠端波形變化，是雙功能超音波判定顯著狹窄的標準。
stages.reasonEn: Doubling of velocity across the lesion (PSV ratio ≥2) with distal waveform change is the duplex criterion for significant stenosis.
stages.pitfall: 若未標示病灶層級：規劃血運重建時無法選擇腔內或繞道策略。
stages.pitfallEn: Without lesion level and length, neither endovascular nor bypass planning is possible.

stages.title: 最佳藥物治療與監督式運動
stages.titleEn: Best medical therapy and supervised exercise
stages.evidence: 病人為跛行無組織缺損；未服抗血小板與他汀，仍每日吸菸。
stages.evidenceEn: Claudication without tissue loss; not on antiplatelet or statin and still smoking daily.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 抗血小板、他汀、戒菸與監督式運動
choices.en: Antiplatelet, statin, smoking cessation, supervised exercise

stages.reason: 指引建議跛行先給予監督式運動與風險因子控制；血運重建保留給治療後仍嚴重受限者。
stages.reasonEn: Guidelines recommend supervised exercise and risk-factor control first for claudication; revascularisation is for persistent limiting symptoms.
stages.pitfall: 若未控制風險因子：跛行病人死於心肌梗塞與中風的機率遠高於截肢。
stages.pitfallEn: Without risk-factor control, claudicants are far more likely to die of MI or stroke than to lose a limb.

stages.title: 何時轉介血運重建評估
stages.titleEn: When to refer for revascularisation work-up
stages.evidence: 右足潰瘍不癒且夜間靜止痛，需垂足睡覺。
stages.evidenceEn: Non-healing right foot ulcer with nocturnal rest pain relieved by dangling the foot.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 符合 CLTI，安排 CTA/MRA 規劃血運重建
choices.en: CLTI: arrange CTA/MRA for revascularisation planning

stages.reason: 靜止痛或組織缺損定義慢性肢體威脅性缺血，需影像規劃並及時血運重建。
stages.reasonEn: Rest pain or tissue loss defines chronic limb-threatening ischaemia and needs imaging and timely revascularisation.
stages.pitfall: 若延誤：潰瘍擴大、感染，一年內大截肢與死亡率顯著上升。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay lets the wound enlarge and become infected; major amputation and mortality within a year rise sharply.

stages.title: 紀錄與衛教回診警訊
stages.evidence: 病人問：「什麼時候要馬上回來？」
stages.evidenceEn: The patient asks: "When must I come back urgently?"
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 新發靜止痛、潰瘍、突然冰冷麻木立即就醫
choices.en: New rest pain, ulcer or sudden cold numb limb: come immediately

stages.reason: 急性肢體缺血與新組織缺損是時間敏感的事件，病人需要明確的回診觸發條件。
stages.reasonEn: Acute limb ischaemia and new tissue loss are time-critical; patients need explicit triggers to return.
stages.pitfall: 若衛教不明確：病人在家等待，急性缺血超過可挽救時間窗。
stages.pitfallEn: Vague advice leaves patients waiting at home while acute ischaemia passes the window for limb salvage.

procedures.title: 腹主動脈瘤篩檢、監測與 EVAR 規劃
procedures.titleEn: AAA screening, surveillance and EVAR planning
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：72 歲男性，曾吸菸，超音波篩檢發現 4.6 cm 腎下型腹主動脈瘤，高血壓與輕度 COPD。本情境用於教學決策，不替代個別評估。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 72-year-old ex-smoker, 4.6 cm infrarenal AAA found on screening ultrasound, hypertension and mild COPD. Teaching scenario; not a substitute for individual assessment.

stages.title: 篩檢對象
stages.evidence: 病人 65 歲以上、曾吸菸男性，從未做過腹部超音波。
stages.evidenceEn: Man over 65 with a smoking history and no previous abdominal ultrasound.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 符合一次性超音波篩檢

stages.reason: 65 歲以上男性一次超音波篩檢可降低 AAA 相關死亡；女性常規篩檢證據不足。
stages.reasonEn: A single ultrasound in men over 65 reduces AAA-related mortality; routine screening of women lacks evidence.
stages.pitfall: 若不篩檢：多數 AAA 無症狀，首次表現就是破裂，死亡率超過一半。
stages.pitfallEn: Unscreened AAAs are silent; the first presentation is often rupture with mortality above 50%.

stages.title: 依直徑決定監測間隔
stages.titleEn: Set the surveillance interval by diameter
stages.evidence: 超音波直徑 4.6 cm，無症狀。
stages.evidenceEn: Ultrasound diameter 4.6 cm, asymptomatic.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?
stages.reason: NICE：3.0–4.4 cm 每年、4.5–5.4 cm 每 3 個月追蹤；較大瘤體成長與破裂風險較高。
stages.reasonEn: NICE: 3.0-4.4 cm yearly, 4.5-5.4 cm every 3 months; larger aneurysms grow and rupture faster.
stages.pitfall: 若間隔太長：瘤體可能在兩次檢查之間越過修補門檻甚至破裂。
stages.pitfallEn: Too long an interval lets the aneurysm cross the repair threshold or rupture between scans.

stages.title: 擇期修補門檻
stages.evidence: 一年後直徑 5.6 cm，仍無症狀。
stages.evidenceEn: A year later the diameter is 5.6 cm, still asymptomatic.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 已達門檻，轉介修補評估
choices.en: Threshold reached: refer for repair assessment

stages.reason: 男性 ≥5.5 cm、有症狀、或一年增長 >1 cm 時修補獲益大於風險；女性門檻較低（約 5.0 cm）。
stages.reasonEn: Repair benefit outweighs risk at ≥5.5 cm in men, when symptomatic or growing >1 cm/year; the threshold in women is lower (about 5.0 cm).
stages.pitfall: 若在小瘤體時修補：手術死亡率超過破裂風險，病人受害而非獲益。
stages.pitfallEn: Repairing small aneurysms exposes patients to operative mortality greater than their rupture risk.

stages.title: 快速增大的瘤體
stages.evidence: 另一病人 4.8 cm，半年前 3.9 cm。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient: 4.8 cm, 3.9 cm six months ago.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 一年增長 >1 cm，視同達門檻
choices.en: Growth >1 cm/year counts as threshold reached

stages.reason: 快速增長代表壁應力與破裂風險升高，指引將其與直徑門檻同等看待；仍應以同一方式複量確認。
stages.reasonEn: Rapid growth implies rising wall stress and rupture risk; guidelines treat it like the diameter threshold, though a repeat measurement by the same method is wise.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略增長速率：小直徑但快速擴張的瘤體在監測中破裂。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignoring growth rate allows a small but fast-expanding aneurysm to rupture under surveillance.

stages.title: 症狀性瘤體
stages.evidence: 病人新發腰背痛，觸診瘤體有壓痛，血壓穩定。
stages.evidenceEn: New back pain with a tender aneurysm on palpation; haemodynamically stable.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 緊急住院與即時影像，準備修補
choices.en: Urgent admission, immediate imaging, prepare for repair

stages.reason: 壓痛或疼痛的瘤體代表即將破裂或已滲漏，不論直徑都應緊急處理。
stages.reasonEn: A tender or painful aneurysm indicates impending or contained rupture and needs urgent management regardless of size.
stages.pitfall: 若當作一般背痛：數小時到數天內可能自由破裂，死亡率驟升。
stages.pitfallEn: Treated as back pain, free rupture may follow within hours to days with very high mortality.

stages.title: 術前心肺風險評估
stages.evidence: COPD、步行受限；心電圖有舊心肌梗塞證據。
stages.evidenceEn: COPD with limited walking; ECG shows an old myocardial infarction.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 心臟評估與心肺運動測試評估耐受度
choices.en: Cardiac work-up and CPET to gauge fitness

stages.reason: 手術死亡主要來自心肺併發症；評估結果影響開放與腔內的選擇及是否修補。
stages.reasonEn: Operative deaths are mostly cardiopulmonary; fitness results drive the open-versus-endovascular choice and whether to repair at all.
stages.pitfall: 若未評估：高風險病人在開放修補中發生心肌梗塞或無法脫離呼吸器。
stages.pitfallEn: Unassessed high-risk patients suffer perioperative MI or fail to wean from ventilation after open repair.

stages.title: CTA 正確量測直徑
stages.evidence: 軸向切面量得 6.2 cm，瘤體明顯彎曲；中心線垂直切面 5.7 cm。
stages.evidenceEn: Axial slice reads 6.2 cm in a tortuous aneurysm; centreline-perpendicular measurement 5.7 cm.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 採用中心線垂直量測外膜到外膜

stages.reason: 斜切的軸向影像高估彎曲瘤體直徑；中心線重建才是支架尺寸與門檻判斷的標準。
stages.reasonEn: Oblique axial slices overestimate tortuous aneurysms; centreline reconstruction is the standard for sizing and threshold decisions.
stages.pitfall: 若用錯量測：支架尺寸錯誤導致內漏或移位，門檻判斷也失真。
stages.pitfallEn: Wrong measurements mis-size the graft, causing endoleak or migration, and distort threshold decisions.

stages.title: 瘤頸解剖是否符合 IFU
stages.titleEn: Does the neck meet the device IFU
stages.evidence: 腎下瘤頸長 8 mm、角度約 75°，頸部有環狀血栓。
stages.evidenceEn: Infrarenal neck 8 mm long, about 75° angulated, with circumferential thrombus.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 不符合標準 IFU，考慮開放或複雜腔內修補
choices.en: Outside standard IFU: consider open or complex endovascular repair

stages.reason: 短、角度大、有血栓的瘤頸使近端密封失敗，是 Type Ia 內漏與移位的主因。
stages.reasonEn: Short, angulated, thrombus-lined necks fail to seal proximally and are the main cause of type Ia endoleak and migration.
stages.pitfall: 若在 IFU 外勉強 EVAR：早期 Type Ia 內漏，瘤體持續加壓並破裂。
stages.pitfallEn: EVAR outside IFU invites early type Ia endoleak with continued pressurisation and rupture.

stages.title: 評估入路血管
stages.evidence: 右髂外動脈直徑 6 mm 嚴重鈣化扭曲；左側 8 mm 通暢。
stages.evidenceEn: Right external iliac 6 mm, heavily calcified and tortuous; left 8 mm and patent.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 右側需開放暴露或導管通道
choices.en: Right side needs open exposure or a conduit

stages.reason: 小而鈣化的髂動脈在推送大口徑輸送系統時會破裂；開放暴露或髂動脈導管通道可降低風險。
stages.reasonEn: Small calcified iliacs rupture when large delivery systems are forced through; open exposure or an iliac conduit mitigates this.
stages.pitfall: 若強行推送：髂動脈破裂造成後腹膜大出血，需緊急覆膜支架或開放修補。
stages.pitfallEn: Forcing the device can rupture the iliac artery with massive retroperitoneal bleeding needing emergency stent-graft or open repair.

stages.title: 預判內漏風險
stages.evidence: CTA 顯示通暢的下腸繫膜動脈與多條粗大腰動脈。
stages.evidenceEn: CTA shows a patent IMA and several large lumbar arteries.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: Type II 內漏風險高，追蹤時注意瘤徑
choices.en: High type II endoleak risk: watch sac size on follow-up

choices.zh: Type I 內漏必然發生

stages.reason: 來自分支的逆流造成 Type II 內漏，多數良性，但瘤體持續增大時需栓塞。
stages.reasonEn: Retrograde branch flow causes type II endoleak, usually benign but requiring embolisation if the sac keeps enlarging.
stages.pitfall: 若未規劃追蹤：持續加壓的瘤體在無症狀中增大，遲發破裂。
stages.pitfallEn: Without planned surveillance, a pressurised sac enlarges silently and can rupture late.

stages.title: 共享決策：開放或腔內
stages.evidence: 病人問：「哪一種手術比較好？」
stages.evidenceEn: The patient asks: "Which operation is better?"
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 說明早期風險、耐久性與終身追蹤的差異後共同決定
choices.en: Explain early risk, durability and lifelong surveillance, then decide together

stages.reason: EVAR 早期死亡率低但再介入與終身影像追蹤多；開放修補早期風險高但長期耐久；需依解剖與體能共享決策。
stages.reasonEn: EVAR has lower early mortality but more reinterventions and lifelong imaging; open repair carries higher early risk but durable results; the choice depends on anatomy and fitness.
stages.pitfall: 若未充分告知：病人無法接受 EVAR 的追蹤負擔或開放手術的早期風險，日後失去信任。
stages.pitfallEn: Poorly informed patients cannot accept the surveillance burden of EVAR or the early risk of open repair, eroding trust.

procedures.title: 腹主動脈瘤腔內修復（EVAR）操作流程
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：74 歲男性，5.8 cm 腎下型 AAA，瘤頸 18 mm，CKD 第 3 期，解剖符合裝置 IFU。本單元只教流程與決策，不含裝置設定與操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 74-year-old man, 5.8 cm infrarenal AAA with an 18 mm neck, CKD stage 3, anatomy within device IFU. Workflow and decisions only; no device settings or operative parameters.

stages.title: 術前核對裝置與影像
stages.evidence: 團隊暫停：確認病人、計畫尺寸、備用組件、血品與腎功能。
stages.evidenceEn: Team time-out: patient, planned sizes, backup components, blood and renal function confirmed.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 確認備用主體與延伸件在場再開始
choices.en: Confirm backup bodies and extensions are present first

stages.reason: EVAR 常需臨時延伸或更換尺寸；缺少組件會在血管開放的情況下被迫中斷。
stages.reasonEn: EVAR often needs an extra extension or a different size; missing components force an interruption with the aorta already accessed.
stages.pitfall: 若未備妥：Type I 內漏無法即時處理，病人帶著未密封的瘤體離開手術室。
stages.pitfallEn: Without backups a type I endoleak cannot be treated on the table and the patient leaves with an unsealed sac.

stages.title: 對比劑腎病預防
stages.evidence: eGFR 42；麻醉詢問對比劑計畫。
stages.evidenceEn: eGFR 42; the anaesthetist asks about the contrast plan.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 術前術後靜脈水化、限制對比劑量
choices.en: Peri-procedural IV hydration and minimise contrast

stages.reason: 靜脈水化是唯一有證據的預防；減少對比劑、避免腎毒性藥物與術後追蹤肌酸酐。
stages.reasonEn: IV hydration is the only evidence-based prevention; minimise contrast, avoid nephrotoxins and recheck creatinine afterwards.
stages.pitfall: 若未預防：CKD 病人發生對比劑急性腎損傷，可能進入透析。
stages.pitfallEn: Unprotected CKD patients develop contrast-associated AKI and may end up on dialysis.

stages.title: 股動脈入路方式
stages.evidence: 超音波見右股總動脈前壁嚴重鈣化；左側無鈣化。
stages.evidenceEn: Ultrasound shows heavy anterior-wall calcification of the right common femoral; left is clean.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 右側開放暴露，左側經皮

stages.reason: 鈣化前壁使經皮閉合裝置失敗率高；開放暴露可直視縫合，另一側仍可經皮以減少傷口。
stages.reasonEn: Calcified anterior walls make closure devices fail; open exposure allows direct suture while the other side stays percutaneous.
stages.pitfall: 若在鈣化處經皮閉合：裝置失敗造成血腫或假性動脈瘤，需再手術。
stages.pitfallEn: Percutaneous closure on calcified walls fails, producing haematoma or pseudoaneurysm needing reoperation.

stages.title: 全身抗凝與硬導絲
stages.evidence: 導絲已進入主動脈；麻醉問是否給肝素。
stages.evidenceEn: Wires are in the aorta; the anaesthetist asks about heparin.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.en: Give after the main body is in

choices.zh: 釋放前依體重給肝素並監測 ACT
choices.en: Weight-based heparin before deployment with ACT monitoring

stages.reason: 大口徑鞘管阻斷血流並刺激血栓；輸送系統進入前就需達到治療性抗凝。
stages.reasonEn: Large sheaths obstruct flow and provoke thrombus; therapeutic anticoagulation is needed before the delivery system enters.
stages.pitfall: 若延遲抗凝：鞘管內或髂股動脈血栓，術後急性肢體缺血。
stages.pitfallEn: Delayed anticoagulation causes sheath or iliofemoral thrombus and postoperative acute limb ischaemia.

stages.title: 消除腎動脈視差
stages.titleEn: Eliminate parallax at the renal arteries
stages.evidence: 正位攝影下腎動脈開口與瘤頸重疊，頸部前傾。
stages.evidenceEn: In the AP projection the renal ostia overlap the neck, which is angled anteriorly.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 調整 C 臂至與瘤頸垂直後再攝影定位
choices.en: Angle the C-arm perpendicular to the neck and re-image

stages.reason: 影像與瘤頸不垂直會讓最低腎動脈位置失真；正確角度才能把覆膜邊緣貼在腎動脈正下方。
stages.reasonEn: A non-perpendicular view distorts the lowest renal position; the correct angle lets the fabric edge sit just below the renal artery.
stages.pitfall: 若視差未消除：覆蓋腎動脈造成腎梗塞，或密封區太短產生 Type Ia 內漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Uncorrected parallax covers a renal artery (renal infarction) or shortens the seal zone (type Ia endoleak).

stages.title: 主體釋放與方向
stages.titleEn: Deploy and orient the main body
stages.evidence: 主體標記顯示對側開口朝向後方，位置在腎動脈下方。
stages.evidenceEn: Main body markers show the contralateral gate facing posteriorly, positioned below the renals.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 釋放前旋轉使開口朝對側髂動脈
choices.en: Rotate so the gate faces the contralateral iliac before release

stages.reason: 開口朝向正確可縮短插管時間；朝後的開口常需耗時的對側或肱動脈抓取技術。
stages.reasonEn: Correct gate orientation shortens cannulation; a posterior gate often forces time-consuming snare or brachial techniques.
stages.pitfall: 若方向錯誤：插管時間延長、對比劑與輻射增加，甚至需轉為主髂單側加股股繞道。
stages.pitfallEn: Malorientation prolongs cannulation, adds contrast and radiation, and may force conversion to aorto-uni-iliac with femoral crossover.

stages.title: 確認導絲在對側開口內
stages.titleEn: Confirm the wire is truly inside the gate
stages.evidence: 導絲似乎已過開口；旋轉的 pigtail 導管在瘤體內不能自由轉動。
stages.evidenceEn: The wire appears through the gate, but a pigtail will not spin freely within the main body.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.en: Call it successful and advance the limb

choices.zh: 導絲可能在主體外，重新插管確認
choices.en: Wire may be outside the body: re-cannulate and confirm

stages.reason: 導管自由旋轉或球囊測試證實導絲在支架腔內；在主體外釋放髂肢等於未修補。
stages.reasonEn: A freely spinning catheter or balloon test proves intraluminal position; a limb deployed outside the body leaves the aneurysm unrepaired.
stages.pitfall: 若誤判：髂肢落在瘤腔內，大量 Type III 內漏，瘤體持續加壓。
stages.pitfallEn: Misjudging this lands the limb in the sac with a large type III endoleak and ongoing pressurisation.

stages.title: 髂肢遠端著陸區
stages.titleEn: Distal landing of the iliac limbs
stages.evidence: 右髂總動脈短且有瘤樣擴張，延伸將跨過內髂動脈開口。
stages.evidenceEn: Short ectatic right common iliac; extension would cross the internal iliac origin.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 保留至少一側內髂，必要時栓塞後分期或用髂分支裝置
choices.en: Preserve at least one internal iliac; stage embolisation or use an iliac branch device
Shorten the landing zone to avoid it

stages.reason: 內髂動脈供應臀肌、腸道與脊髓側枝；雙側喪失可致臀跛行、腸缺血或截癱。
stages.reasonEn: Internal iliacs supply buttock muscles, bowel and spinal collaterals; losing both can cause buttock claudication, bowel ischaemia or paraplegia.
stages.pitfall: 若雙側同時覆蓋又無側枝：術後臀肌壞死與結腸缺血。
stages.pitfallEn: Covering both acutely without collaterals leads to buttock necrosis and colonic ischaemia.

stages.title: 球囊塑形的位置
stages.titleEn: Where to mould with the balloon
stages.evidence: 助手準備在瘤體中段塑形以「貼合」支架。
stages.evidenceEn: The assistant proposes moulding in mid-sac to "seat" the graft.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 只在近端、遠端固定區與重疊處塑形
choices.en: Mould only at proximal/distal seal zones and overlaps

stages.reason: 瘤壁薄弱，球囊在瘤體內擴張可直接造成破裂；塑形的目的只在密封與連接處。
stages.reasonEn: The sac wall is weak and a balloon inflated there can rupture it; moulding is only for seal zones and junctions.
stages.pitfall: 若在瘤體內塑形：術中主動脈破裂，需緊急轉開放手術。
stages.pitfallEn: Moulding inside the sac causes intraoperative rupture requiring emergency open conversion.

stages.title: 完成攝影判讀內漏
stages.evidence: 完成攝影見對比劑自近端密封區沿覆膜外進入瘤腔。
stages.evidenceEn: Contrast tracks from the proximal seal zone outside the fabric into the sac.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: Type II 內漏，追蹤即可
Type Ia 內漏，立即球囊或 cuff 處理
choices.en: Type Ia: treat now with balloon or proximal cuff

stages.reason: Type I 內漏直接把動脈壓傳入瘤腔，等同未修補；須在術中處理，不可觀察。
stages.reasonEn: A type I endoleak transmits systemic pressure to the sac, equivalent to no repair; it must be fixed on the table.
stages.pitfall: 若當作 Type II 觀察：瘤體持續加壓，術後早期破裂。
stages.pitfallEn: Mislabelled as type II, the sac stays pressurised and may rupture early after surgery.

stages.title: 閉合入路與檢查遠端血流
stages.titleEn: Close access and check distal perfusion
stages.evidence: 鞘管移除後，右足背都卜勒訊號消失。
stages.evidenceEn: After sheath removal the right dorsalis pedis Doppler signal is lost.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 立即評估股動脈閉合處與髂肢，考慮取栓或攝影
choices.en: Reassess closure site and limb immediately; consider thrombectomy or angiography

stages.reason: 新的訊號消失代表閉合處狹窄、夾層或髂肢血栓；在手術室內處理最容易。
stages.reasonEn: A new lost signal means closure-site stenosis, dissection or limb thrombosis; it is easiest to fix while still in theatre.
stages.pitfall: 若延遲：髂肢血栓造成急性肢體缺血，可能需繞道或截肢。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay turns limb thrombosis into acute limb ischaemia with possible bypass or amputation.

stages.title: 術後追蹤計畫
stages.evidence: 病人出院前問未來檢查安排。
stages.evidenceEn: Before discharge the patient asks about future scans.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 術後 30 天影像，之後定期終身追蹤
choices.en: Imaging at 30 days, then regular lifelong surveillance

stages.reason: 內漏、移位與瘤徑增大可在多年後無症狀發生；終身影像追蹤是 EVAR 的必要條件。
stages.reasonEn: Endoleak, migration and sac growth can appear silently years later; lifelong imaging is intrinsic to EVAR.
stages.pitfall: 若失去追蹤：遲發 Type I/III 內漏未被發現，發生 EVAR 後破裂。
stages.pitfallEn: Lost to follow-up, late type I/III endoleaks go undetected and post-EVAR rupture occurs.

procedures.title: 開放式腹主動脈瘤修補
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：63 歲男性，6.0 cm 腎下型 AAA，瘤頸短而角度大不適合標準 EVAR，心肺功能良好。本單元教流程與決策，不含縫合細節參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 63-year-old man, 6.0 cm infrarenal AAA with a short angulated neck unsuitable for standard EVAR, good cardiopulmonary fitness. Workflow and decisions only; no suture parameters.

stages.title: 術前準備
stages.evidence: 心臟評估通過；血型交叉完成；討論硬膜外止痛。
stages.evidenceEn: Cardiac work-up passed; blood cross-matched; epidural analgesia discussed.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 備血、硬膜外、ICU 床位與血液回收
choices.en: Blood, epidural, ICU bed and cell salvage ready

stages.reason: 開放修補伴隨大量失血、主動脈夾閉的生理壓力與術後呼吸需求；資源需事先到位。
stages.reasonEn: Open repair involves major blood loss, the physiological stress of aortic clamping and postoperative respiratory demands; resources must be in place.
stages.pitfall: 若準備不足：術中大出血無血品、術後無監測床位，死亡率上升。
stages.pitfallEn: Inadequate preparation means haemorrhage without blood and no monitored bed, raising mortality.

stages.title: 麻醉線路與監測
stages.evidence: 麻醉建立動脈導管、中央靜脈導管與導尿；詢問是否需要額外靜脈通路。
stages.evidenceEn: Arterial line, central line and urinary catheter placed; the anaesthetist asks about additional access.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 大口徑靜脈通路與快速輸液裝置
choices.en: Large-bore access with a rapid infuser

stages.reason: 夾閉釋放與吻合出血可在數分鐘內需要大量輸血；大口徑通路與快速輸液是基本安全。
stages.reasonEn: Declamping and anastomotic bleeding can demand rapid massive transfusion; large-bore access and a rapid infuser are basic safety.
stages.pitfall: 若通路不足：大出血時無法跟上，造成低血壓與器官缺血。
stages.pitfallEn: Insufficient access cannot keep pace with haemorrhage, causing hypotension and organ ischaemia.

stages.title: 選擇手術路徑
stages.evidence: 瘤頸短、需腎上夾閉；病人過去有多次腹部手術。
stages.evidenceEn: Short neck likely needing suprarenal clamp; multiple previous laparotomies.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?
stages.reason: 腹膜後路徑避開腹腔沾黏、利於腎上與腎旁主動脈暴露，且腸道處理與呼吸併發症較少。
stages.reasonEn: The retroperitoneal route avoids adhesions, improves suprarenal and juxtarenal exposure, and has fewer bowel and respiratory complications.
stages.pitfall: 若經腹進入沾黏腹腔：腸損傷與延長手術時間，右髂暴露雖好但腎上控制困難。
stages.pitfallEn: Entering an adherent abdomen risks bowel injury and prolonged surgery, with harder suprarenal control.

stages.title: 近端夾閉位置與時間
stages.evidence: 瘤頸可容納腎下夾閉但壁薄；腎上夾閉可得更健康壁。
stages.evidenceEn: The neck allows an infrarenal clamp on thin wall; a suprarenal clamp would give healthier wall.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 能腎下就腎下，腎上夾閉時間盡量短
choices.en: Infrarenal when possible; keep any suprarenal clamp brief

stages.reason: 每一層級的夾閉都增加腎與內臟缺血；腎上夾閉需在最短時間內完成近端吻合並恢復灌流。
stages.reasonEn: Each higher clamp level adds renal and visceral ischaemia; a suprarenal clamp must be brief and released after the proximal anastomosis.
stages.pitfall: 若腎上夾閉過久：術後急性腎損傷與透析風險顯著增加。
stages.pitfallEn: Prolonged suprarenal clamping markedly raises postoperative AKI and dialysis risk.

stages.title: 夾閉前抗凝與遠端控制
stages.evidence: 髂動脈已游離；準備夾閉。
stages.evidenceEn: Iliac arteries dissected; ready to clamp.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 給肝素，確認後再夾閉近端與遠端
choices.en: Give heparin, confirm, then apply proximal and distal clamps

stages.reason: 夾閉後血流停滯，未抗凝會在髂股動脈形成血栓；遠端夾閉亦防止瘤體操作時碎屑向下栓塞。
stages.reasonEn: Stasis after clamping causes iliofemoral thrombus without anticoagulation; distal clamps also stop debris embolising during sac handling.
stages.pitfall: 若未抗凝：釋放後遠端血栓栓塞，出現垃圾足或急性肢體缺血。
stages.pitfallEn: Without anticoagulation, declamping embolises thrombus causing trash foot or acute limb ischaemia.

stages.title: 切開瘤體與處理腰動脈
stages.titleEn: Open the sac and manage lumbar arteries
stages.evidence: 瘤體切開後多條腰動脈活躍回血；下腸繫膜動脈回血微弱。
stages.evidenceEn: After opening, several lumbars back-bleed briskly; the IMA back-bleeds poorly.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 縫扎腰動脈；IMA 回血差則考慮再植
choices.en: Oversew lumbars; consider IMA reimplantation given poor back-bleeding

stages.reason: 腰動脈回血造成持續失血；IMA 回血差代表側枝不足，結紮可能導致結腸缺血。
stages.reasonEn: Lumbar back-bleeding causes ongoing loss; poor IMA back-bleeding means inadequate collaterals, and ligation risks colonic ischaemia.
stages.pitfall: 若 IMA 側枝不足仍結紮：術後左結腸缺血，敗血症與高死亡率。
stages.pitfallEn: Ligating an IMA with poor collaterals causes left colon ischaemia, sepsis and high mortality.

stages.title: 近端吻合
stages.evidence: 縫合至瘤頸後壁時組織脆弱撕裂。
stages.evidenceEn: The posterior neck wall tears during suturing.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 改以加墊片縫合或向上取更健康壁
choices.en: Use pledgeted sutures or move to healthier wall proximally

stages.reason: 後壁出血難以控制；墊片分散張力，或向更健康的主動脈壁吻合，是安全的補救。
stages.reasonEn: Posterior bleeding is hard to control; pledgets distribute tension, or anastomosing to healthier aorta is the safe salvage.
stages.pitfall: 若硬縫脆弱壁：吻合口撕裂造成難以控制的出血，需再次夾閉與延長缺血。
stages.pitfallEn: Forcing sutures through friable wall tears the anastomosis, causing bleeding, re-clamping and longer ischaemia.

stages.title: 遠端吻合前排氣沖洗
stages.titleEn: Flush and de-air before completing distally
stages.evidence: 遠端吻合即將完成，人工血管內可見碎屑與空氣。
stages.evidenceEn: The distal anastomosis is nearly complete; debris and air are visible in the graft.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先順向與逆向沖洗排氣再打最後針
choices.en: Forward- and back-flush to clear before the final sutures
Release the proximal clamp to test

stages.reason: 殘留碎屑與空氣在釋放時直接進入下肢，造成遠端栓塞。
stages.reasonEn: Retained debris and air embolise straight into the legs on declamping.
stages.pitfall: 若未排氣：垃圾足與小血管栓塞，嚴重時需截肢。
stages.pitfallEn: Without flushing, trash foot and microembolisation occur, occasionally requiring amputation.

stages.title: 夾閉釋放與麻醉協調
stages.evidence: 一側髂夾釋放後血壓從 120 降至 70 mmHg。
stages.evidenceEn: After releasing one iliac clamp the blood pressure falls from 120 to 70 mmHg.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 逐步釋放、通知麻醉補充容量後再放第二側
choices.en: Release gradually, let anaesthesia restore volume before the second side

stages.reason: 釋放後下肢血管床擴張與酸性代謝物回流造成去夾閉低血壓；分段釋放給麻醉時間調整。
stages.reasonEn: Declamping hypotension comes from vasodilated limb beds and washout of acid metabolites; staged release gives anaesthesia time to compensate.
stages.pitfall: 若同時釋放：嚴重低血壓造成心肌缺血與腎灌注不足。
stages.pitfallEn: Simultaneous release causes profound hypotension with myocardial ischaemia and renal hypoperfusion.

stages.title: 覆蓋人工血管
stages.evidence: 吻合完成，瘤壁殘餘可用於包覆人工血管。
stages.evidenceEn: Anastomoses complete; the residual sac wall is available.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 以瘤壁與後腹膜包覆人工血管隔開十二指腸
choices.en: Wrap the graft with sac wall and retroperitoneum away from the duodenum

stages.reason: 人工血管直接接觸十二指腸是主動脈腸瘻的主因；組織隔離是標準步驟。
stages.reasonEn: Direct graft-duodenum contact is the main cause of aortoenteric fistula; tissue interposition is standard.
stages.pitfall: 若未覆蓋：數年後主動脈腸瘻，表現為前哨性消化道出血，死亡率極高。
stages.pitfallEn: Without coverage an aortoenteric fistula can appear years later as herald GI bleeding with very high mortality.

stages.title: 術後 ICU 監測
stages.evidence: 術後 12 小時：少尿、腹脹、乳酸上升、血便一次。
stages.evidenceEn: 12 hours postoperatively: oliguria, abdominal distension, rising lactate, one bloody stool.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 腸道蠕動恢復的正常現象
懷疑結腸缺血，緊急乙狀結腸鏡

stages.reason: 開放修補後血便加乳酸上升是結腸缺血的警訊；早期內視鏡可分辨黏膜與全層壞死。
stages.reasonEn: Bloody stool with rising lactate after open repair signals colonic ischaemia; early endoscopy distinguishes mucosal from transmural necrosis.
stages.pitfall: 若延誤：全層壞死穿孔、糞便性腹膜炎，死亡率超過一半。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay allows transmural necrosis and faecal peritonitis with mortality above 50%.
